pre_condition: label is a non-empty string in file-path notation representing a qualified function name (e.g., 'path/to/file.c::func').
post_condition: Returns a string in FM-Agent canonical FQN form: every path-segment separator ('/') is replaced by the FQN separator ('::'), and the file-extension dot immediately preceding a '::' function separator is replaced by a hyphen ('-'). The returned string contains no '/' characters and uses '::' as segment delimiters throughout.
